newsitem.title: FINLAND: RAISIO SUSPENDED, PLANS NEWS CONFERENCE.
newsitem.headline: RAISIO SUSPENDED, PLANS NEWS CONFERENCE.

text.p: The Helsinki Stock Exchange said on Tuesday trade in food group Raisio had been suspended at the company's request, and a Raisio spokesman said the company would hold a news conference at 1530/1230 GMT in Helsinki.
"It is an important issue for the company," the spokesman said. He did not elaborate, but the company said in a statement the issue was significant and would have impact on its share price.
Before the suspension, Raisio traded unchanged at 370.00 markka.
